text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for taking up your time after 
school, Tsuyoshi, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Learn trends to close the distance with 
students", huh! Totally, knowing what 
everyone likes means we can all get hyped 
together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to us!! We'll teach you tons of 
hot trends!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ..."God-munication"...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It is all the rage in our 
classroom! By speaking divine words... you 
enjoy conversing with others... 
differently than usual!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—"Ye muse upon curious matters indeed. A 
priceless jewel. Everlasting as heaven and 
earth, such bond I shall pray for." ...Hm, 
something like this?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! A total deity! Amazing, President! 
You're so amazing I can't even understand 
what you said!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if a conversation can't even happen, 
that's no good! Jeez, next, next! Next, 
follow meee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's a massive boom on UmaTok right now! 
Ready for the "Funny & Cute Goal 
Declaration!"? 3, 2, 1—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Receiving, receiving. Happy ending, 
incoming." "Receiving, receiving. Charging 
forward, vow is wholehearted-ly chu."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This feels like it could go viral in its 
own way, but... so elegant! This is an 
"Elegant and Noble Goal Declaration"...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, it does not come smoothly. 
Changing conduct ingrained into one's very 
body is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
N-No no no!! The real show starts in the 
afternoon!! Let's eat, let's grab food! 
President, which one will you—

text_block_list.name: Boy at Next Table
text_block_list.text:
—Mommy, there's bell peppers in this 
spaghetti! I don't wanna eat it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aha! That kid's sulking over bell peppers! 
I used to be like that back in the day 
too~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And my mom, determined to get me to eat 
them... cut them into star shapes and 
stuff! Thanks to that, I managed to eat 
them~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Classic! The trick where making it look 
cute lets you eat it! It's weird, but such 
a common thing, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see. Thanks to the two of you, I 
have grasped a clue to breaking the ice 
with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...Ehhhh!? When did that happen!? 
...Whaaaat!? Since wheeeen!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, is it really thanks to us!? Did 
we actually help you out, Prez?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
~~~Alright!! It's not every day the 
President relies on us! I-I'm happy! So 
incredibly happy...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—that is not true, Tsuyoshi. I always 
rely on both of you, ...and indeed, I am 
aided by you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your smiles and the way you forge boldly 
ahead give energy and courage to someone 
like me, who harbors reckless dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That you remain healthy and smiling. That 
is a steadfast beacon guiding me toward 
the ideals I envision. ...If I cannot call 
this help, what else could it be?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Prez...! President...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us eat. After that, I would 
like you to tell me about the things both 
of you are currently into.

While walking down the hallway, I noticed 
Symboli Rudolf with an even more serious 
expression than usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, truthfully, starting today I am 
preparing a new initiative.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, truthfully, starting today I am 
preparing a new initiative.
choice_data_list: I see, I hope it succeeds!
I see, I hope it succeeds!
What on earth are you planning?
What on earth are you planning?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. So that I may meet those eyes 
filled with anticipation, I shall strive 
with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... The hint is 【Cute】. —Look 
forward to the day itself.
